verdict.rationale: Docs show cardholder PIN change via SDK (docs-34) and 3DS enrollment options (OTP and OOB) configurable via API/SDK (docs-9, docs-26, docs-27, docs-32), all avoiding support tickets. However there's no explicit 'PIN reset' flow (only 'change PIN') and no documentation tying 3DS enrollment to region-specific mandates. missing for 10: explicit PIN reset (not just change) flow, region-conditional 3DS enrollment logic/documentation, independent corroboration of these flows working end-to-end.
